name: io.github.Jubstaaa/standup-mr
description: Standup notes from merge request state, with the failed job's error lines.

environmentVariables.name: STANDUP_PROVIDER
environmentVariables.description: Which provider to read: github or gitlab. Omit to auto-detect.

environmentVariables.name: GITHUB_HOST
environmentVariables.description: GitHub host. Defaults to github.com; set it for GitHub Enterprise.

environmentVariables.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: GitHub token. Falls back to the gh CLI session when unset.

environmentVariables.name: GITLAB_HOST
environmentVariables.description: GitLab host. Required for GitLab, which has no default host.

environmentVariables.name: GITLAB_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: GitLab token. Falls back to the glab CLI session when unset.
